name: print-social-cobalt-and-lime-agency-carousel-with-phone
title: Cobalt and lime agency carousel with a circular photo and check-pills
whatItIs: A navy background with a phone showing an Instagram profile and a large post 'We're Not Just Another Agency', plus six smaller posts in cobalt and lime. Each has bold headline text, a circular team photo with lime label pills, a four-point sparkle shape and a footer strip.
whatItMeans: Confident and modern; the lime highlights on cobalt feel like a fresh digital agency.
techniques: Crop a team photo into a circle with pills attached.
Turn key phrases into lime labels with dark text.
Use large four-point sparkle icons as a repeated glyph.
Alternate cobalt and lime cards for rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked into a circle.
A coloured capsule over a photo.
A four-point star used as a decorative icon.
Posts that switch between two brand colours.
